item.tib: g.yung drung dgra 'dul brtsal gyis bsgrubs pa
item.coloph: man ngag spu gri ngar ma 'di/ ma 'ong ('ongs) gshen gyis (gyi) bstan bsrung (srung) yin/ gsang sbas thabs tshul spyod pa bya/ ma gsang bsgrags na dam la 'gal/ dam log khongardzun g.yo zog rigs/ lag tu ma btang sa ma ya/ mkha' 'gro ma'i (mas) kho bo pad ma rje la snyen (snyan) du brgyud / dben gnas mdzod nag du bkod pa dge legs 'phel//
